errors.username_unavailable: This username is already in use on the Computer. Choose a different username.
errors.operation_busy: Another account operation is running. Wait for it to finish and retry.
errors.operation_recovery_required: An operation was interrupted. Check and acknowledge it in My Linux users before retrying.
errors.binding_workspace_conflict: This account is connected to another workspace. Remove its managed daemon there before connecting it here.
errors.binding_conflict: Account availability changed. Refresh and try again.

workspace_linux_users.account_help: Create or verify the Linux account and link it to this workspace. Credentials can be configured later; the daemon is started separately.
workspace_linux_users.required_fields: Choose an available account, or select a Computer and enter a username; then enter the Linux password.
workspace_linux_users.new_account_help: If this username already exists on the Computer, enter its current Linux password to verify ownership. Otherwise, this password will be set for the new account.

admin.title: Admin Area
admin.denied: Only instance administrators can access this page.
admin.disable_help: Disabling blocks new provisioning, sync and upgrades. Running services continue; owners can still uninstall.
admin.connection_help: SSH credentials and host verification are configured by the server operator. Once an account is bound, register a new Computer to change the connection.
admin.bindings_help: Latest 500 Linux User bindings. Check whether an account still exists on its Computer.
admin.audit_help: Latest 200 actions. No passwords, tokens or private keys are shown.
admin.delete_confirm: The Computer is removed from the registry. Its activity log entries are kept. A Computer with bound accounts cannot be deleted; remove those accounts first.
admin.check_help: The connection is checked before the Computer is saved: SSH reachability, passwordless sudo, the provisioning PAM service, and the required system tools. Nothing is installed by a check.
admin.copy_ssh_pubkey_failed: Failed to copy SSH public key
admin.runtimes_prerequisites: npm installs require Node.js and npm in /usr/local/bin or /usr/bin. Login-shell and nvm paths are not loaded. Oh-My-Pi uses a standalone binary.

linux_user.recovery_help: Check the account and operation history before retrying. Removed or detached bindings can be provisioned into your current workspace.
linux_user.retry_help: Account connected; configure credentials and start the daemon in My Linux users.
linux_user.delete_help: Permanently delete this Linux account and its home directory, including code, configuration and credentials. Running processes block deletion. Remove the managed daemon first. This cannot be undone.
linux_user.archive_help: Hide this removed binding and allow Computer deletion. The Linux account, home directory and operation history are retained. Archived ownership stays reserved.
linux_user.acknowledge: I have checked the remote state; allow retry
linux_user.discover_help: Installations run in the background. Follow their result in Recent operations. Rediscover after repairing a CLI or its dependencies.

errors.account_unavailable: Ask an administrator to check account expiry and login policy.
errors.ssh_unreachable: Ask an administrator to check the SSH connection.
errors.ssh_timeout: SSH timed out; check the host before retrying.
errors.sudo_failed: An administrator must restore passwordless sudo.
errors.package_manager_failed: An administrator must repair the package manager.
errors.node_npm_missing: Install Node.js and npm in /usr/local/bin or /usr/bin.
errors.bun_missing: Install the standalone runtime or provide Bun in the managed PATH.
errors.installer_timeout: Installation timed out. Check this Computer’s access to the package source, then retry.
errors.installer_failed: Installer failed; check its source and prerequisites, then retry installation.
errors.runtime_download_failed: Multica Server could not download the runtime. Copy the error information and ask an administrator to check the server download logs, then retry.
errors.version_check_failed: CLI exists but its version command failed; repair dependencies or reinstall.
errors.daemon_offline: Check daemon connectivity, then sync or upgrade.
errors.interrupted: Check the remote account and assets before allowing a retry.
errors.account_delete_failed: Check running processes and permissions, then retry deletion.
errors.remote_step_failed: Check prerequisites, then retry the displayed operation.
errors.credentials_required: This Linux user has no valid Multica API token belonging to you. Start or upgrade the daemon to configure one automatically, or write your own valid token in Account credentials.
errors.credential_transfer_failed: Could not read or write this Linux user’s managed credentials. Check the configuration files and their permissions, then retry.
errors.source_invalid_response: The sub2api response is missing required platform, protocol or pagination metadata. Ask an administrator to check the contract.
errors.source_unauthorized: The directory credential expired or was revoked. Ask an administrator to replace it.
errors.source_not_configured: Ask an administrator to configure the sub2api source.
errors.model_key_unavailable: Ask an administrator to assign an enabled compatible key and verify the source.

errors.model_config_invalid: Check the file syntax and supported paths.
errors.model_config_incomplete: Complete all required files before checking or testing.
errors.model_config_mapping_missing: The existing file uses different field names. Edit it manually; its contents were preserved.
errors.model_auth_failed: The model service rejected the key. Check the saved key and endpoint.
errors.model_connection_failed: The CLI did not return a valid model reply. Check the saved model, endpoint and credential.
errors.model_test_timeout: The CLI test exceeded 60 seconds. Check network access and retry.
errors.model_rate_limited: The model service rate limited this request. Retry later.
errors.model_key_changed: The key or endpoint changed after preview. Load the models and preview again before saving.
errors.model_discovery_failed: Model discovery failed. Check the model service connection and retry.
errors.model_discovery_invalid: The model service returned an invalid model list.
errors.model_discovery_empty: No models were returned for this API key.
errors.model_key_unassigned: Ask an administrator to assign an enabled compatible key and verify the source.
errors.model_key_runtime_forbidden: Ask an administrator to assign an enabled compatible key and verify the source.
errors.model_key_metadata_missing: Ask an administrator to assign an enabled compatible key and verify the source.
errors.source_changed: The source changed. Refresh the key list and retry.
errors.source_unavailable: Cannot reach the directory source. Ask an administrator to check the connection.
errors.source_rate_limited: The directory service rate limited the request. Refresh later.
errors.source_encryption_unavailable: Cannot decrypt the directory credential. Ask an administrator to check the server encryption key.

errors.model_template_invalid: The runtime template is invalid. Ask an administrator to repair it.
errors.model_selection_required: Choose a protocol and model compatible with this key and runtime.

errors.model_cli_protocol_failed: The CLI did not complete model selection or the connection protocol. Check its version.

linux_user.prompt_password: Enter the Linux password in the setup form, then execute the selected action.

credential_page.authenticate: Enter the Linux password for {{username}} to authorize this operation.
credential_page.title: Personal credentials
credential_page.help: All fields are optional. Save a personal template here, or read settings from one of your Linux users. Creating an account does not require credentials.
credential_page.transfer_help: Read replaces this draft with the account’s settings. Write applies non-empty fields to this account and preserves remote values for blank fields. It does not start or restart the daemon.
credential_page.read_done: Settings read into the form. Review them before saving or writing.
credential_page.write_done: Settings written. Start or restart the daemon from Overview to apply them.
credential_page.saved: Personal credentials saved. Remote accounts were not changed.
credential_page.no_accounts: Create or verify a Linux user in My Linux users first.
credential_page.locations: Reads ~/.gitconfig and ~/.config/multica-provision/, plus the binding’s ~/.multica/profiles/computer-<binding-id>/config.json. Shell startup files and vendor CLI login sessions are not imported.

field_help.git_name: Your Git commit author name. Read the current value with git config --global user.name as the target Linux user.
field_help.git_email: Use an email verified by your Git hosting service. Read it with git config --global user.email.
field_help.gitlab_url: Your GitLab site origin, for example https://gitlab.example.com. Required only when using a GitLab token.
field_help.gitlab_token: Create in GitLab user settings → Access tokens. For Git over HTTPS, grant only the repository read/write permissions you need. Optional when using SSH.
field_help.git_ssh_key: Use a dedicated private SSH key for Git access; register its .pub key with GitLab. This is separate from the Computer operator key. Passphrase-protected keys are not supported.
field_help.git_known_hosts: Trusted SSH host key entries for your Git server, from a verified ~/.ssh/known_hosts. Verify host fingerprints before trusting keys obtained with ssh-keyscan.
field_help.model_env: Create API keys in the relevant provider console. Supported names: OPENAI_API_KEY, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, OPENROUTER_API_KEY, GEMINI_API_KEY, XAI_API_KEY. One KEY=value per line.
field_help.multica_pat: Optional. Starting or upgrading the daemon automatically configures a token for your Multica account. To supply one manually, create it under Settings → API tokens.

credential_page.remote_source: Credentials read from {{username}}. Switching accounts discards this draft and restores your personal template.
credential_page.confirm_import: Save these remote credentials, including secrets, as my personal template for use with other Linux users.

tables.error_copy_failed: Could not copy. Expand the details and select the error text to copy it manually.

linux_user_pages.empty: No Linux users match this list.
linux_user_pages.empty_accounts: You don't have a Linux user yet. Creating one connects it to your current workspace. You can add credentials and start the daemon afterwards.
linux_user_pages.empty_search: No Linux users match this search.

hints.running: This is still running. You can leave and come back when it finishes.
hints.interrupted: The last operation stopped. Confirm the remote state before trying again.
hints.missing: This Computer no longer has the account. You can create it again.
hints.unavailable: The account cannot be used right now. Read the operation record before changing it.
hints.unverified: Enter this account's current Linux password to confirm it is yours. The password will not be changed.
hints.pending: This account is yours, but it cannot run yet. Write your access token, then start the daemon.
hints.removed: The account and its files are still there. Verify it when you want to connect again.
hints.detached: Its previous workspace is gone. Verify it to connect to a workspace you still belong to.
hints.ready: Ready to run in the workspace it is connected to.
hints.failed: The last operation did not finish. Retry after reading the reason. The account was not deleted.
hints.unknown: Open this account to see what needs attention.

linux_user_pages.no_workspace: Join or create a workspace before connecting a Linux user. If workspaces could not be loaded, close this dialog and retry.
linux_user_pages.configure_first: Verify the account and resolve any interrupted operation in Overview before configuring it.
linux_user_pages.discard_help: Leaving this tab clears the password and credential draft. Unsaved changes will be lost.
linux_user_pages.template_help: This template can be loaded explicitly when configuring a Linux user. Saving it does not change any server account.
linux_user_pages.replace_draft: Replace the current draft with the template or server response.

runtime_versions.batch_help: Installs run one at a time; failed items are skipped and current versions are kept. Keep the app open until the batch finishes.
runtime_versions.batch_stopped: Batch stopped because the current operation could not be confirmed. Check operation history before retrying.

runtime_cache.title: Runtime cache
runtime_cache.help: Downloads are cached on Multica Server and reused across Linux users.
runtime_cache.clear_help: Installed CLIs are kept. Future installations will download these files again.
runtime_cache.installer_only: Installer script; other downloads depend on the upstream installer
runtime_cache.empty: Files are cached when versions are checked or CLIs are installed.

model_configuration.source_help: One credential accesses all keys under the shared sub2api account. Changing the URL clears user assignments.
model_configuration.credential_hint: Enter a new credential to replace the saved one
model_configuration.search_users: Search users by name or email
model_configuration.grant_help: The first available compatible key is the initial default for each runtime. Users can choose another assigned key. Revoking an assignment does not delete credentials already saved on Linux; revoke them in sub2api too if needed.
model_configuration.template_help: Templates initialize new configurations only. Existing user files keep their own content and field mappings. Do not put real API keys in templates.
model_configuration.bindings_help: Map existing field paths to api_key_token, base_url, model_id or api_type. Values are escaped for each file format.
model_configuration.private_help: These files may contain full API keys. Changes are saved privately for this Linux user.
model_configuration.preview_help: Preview updates only the draft. Review the complete files before saving.
model_configuration.valid: Required files, syntax and managed fields are valid. Run a CLI test to check the connection.
model_configuration.cost_help: The CLI test sends one short model request using this Linux user’s saved configuration and may incur a charge.
model_configuration.no_keys: No compatible key is assigned. Ask an administrator to assign one. Existing files can still be edited and tested.
model_configuration.failed: Operation failed. Retry or copy the error details for an administrator.
model_configuration.conflict: The saved configuration changed. Reload before saving; your current draft is still shown.
